artworks.title: Theseus and Peirithoos in the Underworld (Apulian volute-krater)
artworks.description: Karlsruhe BL B 4: Hades and Persephone enthroned while Theseus and Peirithoos sit among the damned — Heracles with Cerberus nearby, the Chair of Forgetfulness as South Italian underworld map.

artworks.title: Theseus and Pirithous Abducting Helen
artworks.description: Palagi's neoclassical abduction: the oath to marry daughters of Zeus begins with Helen at Aphidnae — the crime that sends the pair down for Persephone.

popCulture.title: Pirithous
popCulture.description: Theseus' sworn brother who would marry Persephone — bound on Hades' Chair of Forgetfulness for the hubris of that oath.

popCulture.title: Theseus
popCulture.description: The Athenian who hid Helen and went down for Persephone — Heracles freed him; Pirithous stayed below.
